summary: This is an extraction of Sri Lakshmi Bearing House's rate card (photograph attachment) covering bearing assemblies, from which three SKUs plausibly answer the three RFQ variants. The document is a general price list rather than a quotation: it carries no offer number, no quantities and no availability statement, is photographed at an angle so that description/series/rate columns are visually offset, and adds P&F 1% plus GST 18% on top of the listed per-piece rates.

ambiguities: Document is a general rate card, not a quotation against RFQ-2026-MCH-005: no offer number, no quantities confirmed against the 40/24/20 nos required, and no commitment against the 2026-11-18 need-by date (12-13 weeks from PO).

Variant mapping is inferred: the card has no 'Standard', 'Heavy-duty' or 'High-speed' RFQ labels; SL-A6212 'General duty', SL-ANU316 'Heavy duty' and SL-A7014P4 'High speed' were matched by description. Buyer should confirm SL-A6212 (and not SL-A6205/SL-A6308) is the intended standard assembly.

Photograph is skewed, so description/series/rate columns are visually offset from the SKU column; the rate-to-SKU alignment (650/1,180/2,150/890/4,300/5,900/7,800/1,420 in SKU order) should be confirmed with the vendor.
Prices exclude Packing & forwarding 1% and GST 18% — landed price differs from the listed per-piece rate.
Credit is '30 days from GRN', not days from invoice date as requested in the RFQ.
Freight is 'to pay' on ex-godown Chennai prices, so delivery cost to the buyer is unquantified.
Minimum order value ₹25,000 and 'rates subject to change without notice' mean the prices are not firm for the RFQ validity period.
The ISO 15243 certificate number SLBH-15243-221 appears to be self-referenced (SLBH = Sri Lakshmi Bearing House); no issuing/accredited body is named for either certificate.
